design.purpose: Serves one person as a warm lap blanket: chunky two-colour striped rectangle worked in single crochet, using the green yarn then the blue yarn. Confirm enough yarn for the stated size before starting; yardage is not known from the photograph.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface.
Place the blue yarn beside the green yarn.
Ch 31 with green yarn; foundation ready for 30 stitches.
Row 1: sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, 30 sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 2-10: ch 1, turn, 30 sc across each row, green stripes.
Cut the green yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Rows 11-20: join blue, ch 1, turn, 30 sc across each row.
Fasten off and cut blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Weave in all tails with the needle, working back and forth.
